description:
Know what you pay for, and decide before every renewal.

Pausely keeps every subscription in one calm place. Before each charge it asks one question: keep it or cancel it? Every cancellation goes on your Savings Receipt, so you can see exactly what you saved.

WHAT YOU GET
• A reminder before every renewal, with the facts to decide: what it costs a year, what its renewals have come to so far, whether its price went up, and what an hour of use costs you. Keep it right from the reminder, or see how to cancel.
• Your Savings Receipt: every charge your cancellations avoided, with dates you can check
• Pause Plan: watch one streaming service at a time and rotate monthly. Pausely tells you when to cancel and when to start again.
• Home shows what your subscriptions cost each month, every charge that's coming and what leaves by any day
• 800+ popular services to add in seconds, or add your own
• Reminders 1, 3 or 7 days before, the day before and on the day
• Free-trial reminders before you'd be charged
• How to cancel, free for everyone: the cancellation page of 500+ services, and the steps for anything billed through the App Store
• Price history for every subscription
• Cost per hour of use, from the hours you enter
• 130+ currencies, with totals converted to yours
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and Shortcuts
• Your year in subscriptions, on a slip you can share
• Export your list whenever you like

THE PAUSELY PROMISE
Pausely tracks its own subscription too. It shows what your cancellations are saving you against what Pausely costs, and if it isn't worth it, it tells you to cancel it.

FREE AND PRO
Track up to 5 subscriptions for free, with reminders, the keep-or-cancel question, how to cancel and your Savings Receipt. Pausely Pro tracks all of them and adds Pause Plan.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no third-party trackers, and we never sell your data. Your decisions, your history and your Savings Receipt stay on your iPhone.

Available in English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese and Arabic.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Pausely Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://pausely.pro/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://pausely.pro/privacy.html
Support: pausely@proton.me
